g.text: All three required by the model.
On any exception, addexpense.js logs 'falling back to "Others"' but actually sets finalDescription = "" — the log
message and the real fallback value disagree. Documented as a confirmed finding, not fixed.
No ML model touched at all
Despite living in inference/, this endpoint never
reads predictor_manager, MongoDB, or any joblib

svg.text: Heavy arrows are region hand-offs; the cyan one is the HTTP response. Light arrows are steps inside a region. Absent mechanisms are named in a note, never drawn as implemented steps.
A failure here never blocks expense creation — addexpense.js catches it locally and proceeds.
